dispatch_time_tips_detail:
Separated by commas, the content of the parameters are:
1, charge and discharge active power for battery / ECO Mode rechargeable battery / SB for FCAS Mode
2, charge and discharge reactive power for battery / ECO Mode continuous Time (seconds) / DB of FCAS Mode
3, battery charge and discharge SOC
4, ControlMode
1), Battery only charges from PV;
2), State of Charge control;
3), Load Follow;
4), Maximize Output;
5), Normal Mode;
6), Optimize Consumption;
7), Maximize Consumption
8), ECO Mode
9), FCAS Mode
parameter: 32000,90,0,8 (EMS-enabled Eco-Mode mode: battery can be charged and discharged for 90 seconds)
